observations: Five-star black plastic base with casters.
Gas lift cylinder visible for height adjustment.
Medium-height backrest with a slight ergonomic curve.
The chair is shown in an outdoor or warehouse-style setting with other furniture.

claims.evidence: photo 1 shows a gas lift cylinder and adjustment lever
the backrest has a curve but no visible dedicated or adjustable lumbar mechanism
the underside mechanism is not clearly visible in any photo

risks.risk: The gas lift may be 'sinking' and unable to hold height under weight.
risks.proof: Video of a person sitting on the chair at its highest setting.

risks.risk: The tilt/recline mechanism may be jammed or the tension spring broken.
risks.proof: Video showing the chair reclining and the tension knob being turned.

risks.risk: One or more casters (wheels) may be seized or broken.
risks.proof: Video of the chair being rolled across the floor.

proof_requests: Video of the chair being sat on to test the gas lift.
Video of the chair rolling to check the casters.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standard office task chair. While mechanical functions are unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case functional state based on the visual evidence.
